props.text:
# Postmortem INC-102: checkout-api 5xx rate 61% over 5m

Started: 2026-10-11T14:20:00Z
Resolved: not yet resolved
Root cause confirmed by: asha

## Summary
checkout-api 5xx rate 61% over 5m. First alert on checkout-api.

## Root cause
cardnet (CardNet Acquiring outage) in payments-core.

## What the investigation found
- (precedent) INC-101 (Payments timeouts from a ledger retry storm) hit payments-core on the same dependency chain; it was caused by PR-377 and fixed by PR-380.
- (customers) 5 customers use features that depend on payments-core: Larkspur Retail, Bluepeak Travel, Kite Grocers, Mosaic Books, Tandem Fitness. Combined monthly revenue $98,800.
- (sla) SLA credits at risk: $8,200 a month across 3 contracts. Larkspur Retail 99.95% (21.6 min of downtime allowed a month, $4,200 credit); Bluepeak Travel 99.95% (21.6 min of downtime allowed a month, $3,100 credit); Kite Grocers 99.9% (43.2 min of downtime allowed a month, $900 credit).
- (root_cause) Most likely cause: cardnet (CardNet Acquiring outage) in payments-core, score 0.9.
- (commitment) Clara Jensen promised Bluepeak Travel on 2026-08-20: "We will notify Bluepeak within 15 minutes of any incident that affects the Payments API." (email/2026-08-20-bluepeak-incident-notice.eml)
- (constraint) Any fix to payments-core must keep ADR-5 (Fraud scoring is synchronous with a 300 ms timeout) in force. Its recorded risk: A slow fraud-scorer adds at most 300 ms to a charge.
- (constraint) Any fix to payments-core must keep ADR-7 (Cap the ledger pool at 20 connections per payments pod) in force. Its recorded risk: Under burst traffic, requests beyond the pool size fail immediately unless a bounded wait queue is added in front of the pool.
- (requirement) Requirement at risk on checkout-api: checkout-api must sustain 500 charges per second for the duration of a customer sale event. (requested by Larkspur Retail)
- (requirement) Requirement at risk on payments-core: payments-core must answer 99% of charges within 800 ms during sale events.
- (requirement) Requirement at risk on payments-core: Merchants on enterprise plans must be told about any payments incident within 15 minutes.
- (expertise) Best reviewers for payments-core: Asha Rao (3 changes), Ravi Menon (3 changes), Tomas Novak (1 changes)

## Resolution
- No code change merged.
